<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
diag(x) -> 'core.SymbolicTensor'
```

Part of [`evoxc.ops`](/api/evoxc/ops/)

Extract the main diagonal, or build a diagonal matrix (numpy `diag`
semantics).

## Parameters

- `x` — `SymbolicTensor` or Python scalar of rank 1 (→ `(n, n)`
  diagonal matrix) or rank 2 (→ the main diagonal `(min(m, n),)`).

## Returns

- `'core.SymbolicTensor'` — `SymbolicTensor`; dtype preserved in both directions.

## Raises

- `core.TraceError` — no active trace; concrete `Tensor` operand.

- `core.ShapeError` — rank not 1 or 2 (numpy raises `ValueError`; evoxc
  uses `ShapeError`).
